ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left side of the figure there are three-phase terminals U, V, W. On the right side is a triangular connection composed of three identical impedances Z; terminal U is connected to the upper vertex of the triangle, and terminal W is connected to the lower-left vertex. One end of the voltmeter is connected to phase V, and the other end is connected to the lower-right vertex of the triangle; this lower-right vertex is the node connected to U and W respectively through two equal impedances. Then reason: it is known that U_UV = 380 V is the line voltage. Let the magnitude of the balanced three-phase phase voltage be E, then E = 380 / sqrt(3). Take the phase-voltage phasors V_U = E∠0°, V_V = E∠-120°, V_W = E∠120°. Since the ideal voltmeter draws no current, the lower-right node x is located in the middle of the two equal impedances connecting U and W, therefore V_x = (V_U + V_W) / 2. The voltmeter reading is |V_x - V_V|. Substituting the phasors gives |V_x - V_V| = 3E/2 = 3 × 380 / (2sqrt(3)) ≈ 329 V, which is taken as approximately 330 V according to the options or significant figures.

raw_record.question_text: In the three-phase circuit shown in the figure, given \(U_{UV} = 380 \, V\), what is the reading of the voltmeter?

method.method_draft: From the image, identify that the voltmeter measures from phase V to the junction of the two equal delta impedances connected to U and W. From the text, take U_UV=380 V as the line-to-line voltage, so the phase voltage magnitude is E=380/sqrt(3). Choose balanced phase phasors V_U=E∠0°, V_V=E∠-120°, V_W=E∠120°. Because the junction is between equal impedances connected to U and W and the voltmeter is ideal, V_x=(V_U+V_W)/2. Compute |V_x-V_V| = 3E/2 = 3*380/(2sqrt(3)) ≈329 V, reported as 330 V.

再推理：已知 U_UV = 380 V 为线电压。设三相平衡相电压幅值为 E，则 E = 380 / sqrt(3)。取相电压相量 V_U = E∠0°，V_V = E∠-120°，V_W = E∠120°。由于电压表理想不取电流，右下结点 x 位于连接 U 与 W 的两个相等阻抗中间，因此 V_x = (V_U + V_W) / 2。电压表读数为 |V_x - V_V|。代入相量可得 |V_x - V_V| = 3E/2 = 3 × 380 / (2sqrt(3)) ≈ 329 V，按选项或有效数字取约为 330 V。

method.method_draft: Use V as the reference terminal. From the image, the voltmeter reads |V_x−V_V|, where x is the midpoint of two equal impedances tied to U and W, hence V_x−V_V = [(V_U−V_V)+(V_W−V_V)]/2.
